headlines.title: 丁向群与加拿大财政部长商鹏飞共同主持召开中加金融监管合作会议
headlines.summary: 当地时间2026年11月8日，国家金融监督管理总局党委书记、局长丁向群与加拿大财政部长商鹏飞成功主持召开中加金融监管合作会议。来自中国人民银行、金融监管总局、中国证监会，以及加拿大财政部、中央银行、金融机构监管署的代表参加了会议。双方就金融市场最新发展情况、金融业双向开放等议题进行深入交流，取得积极成果。会议期间，金融监管总局与加拿大金融机构监管署共同签署了《关于中加金融监管对话的合作协议》。会议还对此前双方重启中加金融监管对话机制并召开新一轮对话表示欢迎。（国家金融监督管理总局网站）

headlines.title_en: Ding Xiangqun and Canadian Finance Minister Francois-Philippe Champagne co-chair the China-Canada Financial Regulatory Cooperation Meeting
headlines.summary_en: On November 8, 2026, Ding Xiangqun, Party Secretary and Director of the National Financial Regulatory Administration (NFRA), and François-Philippe Champagne, Canada's Minister of Finance, successfully co-chaired the China-Canada Financial Regulatory Cooperation Meeting. Representatives from the People's Bank of China (PBOC), the NFRA, the China Securities Regulatory Commission (CSRC), as well as Canada's Department of Finance, Bank of Canada, and Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions attended the meeting. The two sides held in-depth exchanges on topics including the latest developments in financial markets and two-way opening of the financial sector, achieving positive results. During the meeting, the NFRA and Canada's Office of the Superintendent of Financial Institutions jointly signed the Cooperation Agreement on the China-Canada Financial Regulatory Dialogue. The meeting also welcomed the earlier relaunch of the China-Canada financial regulatory dialogue mechanism by both sides and the convening of a new round of dialogue. (NFRA website)

headlines.title: 美国劳工统计局将不公布10月CPI同比数据 受去年政府停摆影响
headlines.summary: 备受关注的美国消费者价格指数报告将缺少一些关键数据：同比百分比变化。通常，美国劳工统计局公布的CPI报告会显示价格较前一个月以及较一年前发生了怎样的变化。后一项数据通常也是公众理解通胀水平的方式；9月该数据为3.7%。 由于2025年美国政府停摆，周二公布的10月数据将无法提供这一同比指标。

headlines.title_en: US Bureau of Labor Statistics will not publish October CPI year-on-year data due to last year's government shutdown
headlines.summary_en: The closely watched US consumer price index report will be missing some key data: the year-on-year percentage change. Normally, the CPI report published by the US Bureau of Labor Statistics shows how prices changed from the previous month and from a year earlier. The latter figure is also typically how the public understands the inflation level; in September it was 3.7%. Due to the 2025 US government shutdown, the October data released on Tuesday will not be able to provide this year-on-year metric.

headlines.title_en: Jinyi Technology: plans to acquire 12% equity of Xinlian Payment for 21.6 million yuan, raising stake to 35%
headlines.summary_en: Jinyi Technology announced that the company plans to acquire a 12% equity stake in Shandong Hi-Speed Xinlian Payment Co., Ltd. for 21.6 million yuan in cash. After the transaction is completed, the company's equity stake in Xinlian Payment will increase from 23.00% to 35.00%. Xinlian Payment will remain an associate company of the company and will not be included in the company's consolidated financial statements. Xinlian Payment is a third-party payment institution regulated by the People's Bank of China. The transaction is still subject to approval by the PBOC, and the timing of equity delivery is uncertain.

headlines.title_en: Wang Yi holds talks with Slovak Foreign Minister Juraj Blanar
headlines.summary_en: On November 10, 2026, Wang Yi, Member of the Political Bureau of the CPC Central Committee and Foreign Minister, held talks in Beijing with Slovak Foreign Minister Juraj Blanár. Wang Yi said that China and Slovakia enjoy traditional friendship. In recent years, under the joint guidance of the leaders of both countries, the China-Slovakia strategic partnership has maintained a high level of performance, and cooperation in various fields has achieved positive results, becoming a model of friendly coexistence, equal treatment and win-win cooperation between countries of different sizes and different systems. China and Slovakia share extensive common ideas and common interests. China is willing to work with Slovakia to further consolidate political mutual trust, strengthen strategic coordination, fully unleash cooperation potential, and contribute to the healthy development of China-Europe relations and world peace and stability through higher-quality and higher-level bilateral relations. (Ministry of Foreign Affairs website)

headlines.title: 法国失业率小幅下降 令疲弱的经济稍获喘息
headlines.summary: 法国第三季度失业率略有下降，这给正面临抗议活动和预算不确定性等不利因素、并濒临衰退的经济带来些许缓解。法国统计部门Insee表示，第三季度失业率从上一季度的8.3%降至8.2%，预期为升至8.4%。法国央行周一表示，经济增速将在2026年最后一个季度“温和”回升，但同时警告称，存在异常高的不确定性，未给出精确的估计。Insee的数据显示，15-24岁人群的失业率下降至21%，而50岁以上人群的失业率略微上升至5.6%，为2022年初以来的最高水平。

headlines.title_en: France's unemployment rate edges down, giving the weak economy some respite
headlines.summary_en: France's unemployment rate edged down in the third quarter, offering some relief to an economy that is facing headwinds including protests and budget uncertainty and is on the brink of recession. French statistics agency Insee said the unemployment rate fell to 8.2% in the third quarter from 8.3% in the previous quarter, against expectations of a rise to 8.4%. The Bank of France said on Monday that economic growth would pick up "moderately" in the final quarter of 2026, but warned that uncertainty was unusually high and did not provide a precise estimate. Insee data showed that the unemployment rate for people aged 15-24 fell to 21%, while the unemployment rate for people over 50 rose slightly to 5.6%, the highest level since early 2022.

headlines.title_en: Chengda Biotech: plans share buyback of 25 million to 50 million yuan
headlines.summary_en: Chengda Biotech announced that it plans to use part of its excess raised funds to repurchase company shares through centralized bidding, with total repurchase funds of no less than 25 million yuan (inclusive) and no more than 50 million yuan (inclusive), and a repurchase price of no more than 30 yuan per share (inclusive). The repurchased shares are all intended to be cancelled, with a corresponding reduction in the company's registered capital. Based on the upper limit of the repurchase price, the expected number of repurchased shares is approximately 833,300 to 1,666,700 shares, accounting for approximately 0.20% to 0.40% of the company's total share capital. The repurchase period is within 12 months from the date the shareholders' meeting approves the repurchase proposal.

headlines.title: 欧洲央行管委Kazaks：货币政策仍需维持一些鹰派姿态
headlines.summary: 欧洲央行管委Kazaks：货币政策仍需维持一些鹰派姿态。 我们必须保持警惕、谨慎。 必须在不过度损害经济的前提下控制通货膨胀。 政策必须阻止能源通胀外溢。 2027年通胀率可能大幅超过4%。 如果能源情势持续，可能需要进一步收紧货币政策。 欧洲央行无需放缓或停止量化紧缩政策。 政府债券收益率上升可能拖慢经济。 法国债券压力是对财政风险的重新定价。

headlines.title_en: ECB Governing Council member Kazaks: monetary policy still needs to maintain some hawkish posture
headlines.summary_en: ECB Governing Council member Kazaks: Monetary policy still needs to maintain some hawkish stance. We must remain vigilant and cautious. Inflation must be controlled without excessively damaging the economy. Policy must prevent energy inflation from spilling over. Inflation may significantly exceed 4% in 2027. If the energy situation persists, further monetary tightening may be needed. The ECB does not need to slow or stop quantitative tightening. Rising government bond yields may slow the economy. French bond stress is a repricing of fiscal risk.
